G SUNDARI +91 9500547285| sundarigunasekar05@gmail.com

| Chennai, India

SUMMARY

Middle Office professional with 5.5 years of experience in Capital Markets and Investment Banking Operations, in Indian Listed Derivatives (Futures & Options), Trade Booking, Clearing, Settlement and Middle Office Operations. Hands-on experience in managing the end-to-end trade lifecycle, including trade validation, give-up/take-up processing, clearing, settlement, exception management, and trade, cash and position reconciliations. Experienced in supporting institutional clients, traders, brokers, custodians and clearing members while ensuring timely resolution of operational queries and settlement breaks. Strong knowledge of Exchange Traded Derivatives (ETD), Cash Equities, Fixed Income, Mutual Funds, ABS & MBS products. Proficient in client onboarding, account setup, portfolio migrations, account closures, SWIFT payment processing (MT202, MT299 & MT105), accounting entries, settlement instruction (SSI) validation, operational risk controls. Skilled in market data validation, corporate action analysis, root cause analysis, audit support, UAT testing, process improvement and process documentation. Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management skills with focus on delivering exceptional client service.

WORK EXPERIENCE

Operational Analyst | Barclays Global Service Centre Private Limited | (June 2025- Jan 2026)

Ensured Trade Store and Risk Store alignment by implementing (SIP) controls, validating counterparty codes, trader details and product taxonomy.

Executed daily T+1 and SD+1 reconciliations across Front Office, Middle Office, and Back Office systems, escalating aged breaks and driving timely resolution.

Delivered MIS dashboards, break reports, and daily control packs for senior management, highlighting

operational KPIs and volume trends.

Performed FOBO/MOBO reconciliations across equity derivatives, options, bonds, credits and

structured products ensuring data integrity between risk and settlement systems.

Supported internal and external audit reviews by providing operational evidence, reconciliation reports and

process documentation. Performed operational control checks to ensure compliance

Conducted root cause analysis of operational exceptions, recommended corrective actions, and supported

process optimization initiatives to improve STP rates.

Investigated reconciliation exceptions through detailed root cause analysis and coordinated with Front Office,

Operations, Technology and external counterparties for timely closure.

Escalated funding shortages, settlement risks, and operational exceptions to management and relevant stakeholders within agreed timelines.

Maintained and updated SOPs, control documents, operational procedures to support audit & governance

Associate Level 1 (Securities Services) | BNP Paribas India Solution Pvt Ltd | Sep 2023- June 2025

Developed and executed asset transition plans for migrating client portfolios, accounts, and business

functions, ensuring seamless onboarding and offboarding.

Managed portfolio onboarding, account migrations and offboarding activities, including SSI validation,

settlement account setup and custody alignment.

Supported onboarding of institutional clients via account setup, trade flow and settlement instruction validation. - Validated post-migration cash and security balances to ensure successful transition without operational impact. - Managed portfolio migrations, tax reclaims, and account closures, coordinating with custodians and clients for smooth transitions. Monitored and ensured timely settlement of securities and cash transactions across global markets and custodians

- Performed end to end analysis of multi asset products(equities, bonds, options, futures, repos, CDS,

MBS, swaps, OTC derivatives), validating cash flows, pricing, performance reporting.

Conducted manual reconciliations of trader blotters vs booking systems, ensuring no missing or duplicated

trades. Monitored intraday cash balances and funding requirements for derivatives, equities & FI. - Provided timely operational support for trade amendments, booking corrections, give-up status and

settlement confirmations throughout the trade lifecycle.

Transferred stocks and cash to external custodians, reconciling cash, securities, and trade data between

internal and external sources; partnered with Fund accounting for NAV sign offs.

Supported UAT testing, system deployments, and CCP changes, collaborating with technology teams

via JIRA and ServiceNow until successful go live.

Performed daily cash, position and trade reconciliations using Intellimatch to identify external, internal and

shadow portfolio breaks. Providing accurate MIS dashboards for senior management.

Posted accounting entries for settlement activities and reconciled accounting records with custody balances. - Managed client account investigations, fund transfers, cash reconciliations to ensure accounting and settlement - Investigated and resolved trade discrepancies related to notional, rate, maturity, currency,settlement instructions & counterparty details within SLA. Verified trade economics against FO bookings before releasing confirmations. - Processed internal and external cash movements using SWIFT MT202, MT299 and MT105 messages. - Monitored nostro cash balances and coordinated internal fund transfers to avoid payment settlement failures.

Associate | Incedo technology Solutions Ltd| Feb 2023- July 2023 - Managed end-to-end trade booking and validation for Indian Listed Derivative (Futures & Options) trades

executed on NSE/BSE, ensuring accurate capture of trade economics prior to clearing.

Managed failed give-up scenarios by booking unmatched trades into pending accounts& re-submitting instruction - Performed daily control checks to identify unmatched, cancelled, amended, and rejected OTC derivative trades.

Performed trade validation against exchange confirmations by verifying contract specifications, price, quantity, expiry, client account, broker code and settlement details before releasing trades for downstream processing.

Liaised with front office, middle office, custodians, ops teams to ensure trade settlement, escalation of exceptions - Coordinated with clients and treasury teams for margin call settlements and collateral optimization activities

Monitored STP trade flow from exchange interfaces into internal trade capture systems (LISA and UBIX),

investigating and resolving trade capture failures and booking exceptions.

Performed daily reconciliation of executed trades against clearing statements to ensure accuracy of positions. - Investigated settlement breaks arising from quantity, contract, price, trade date mismatches resolved within SLA

Analyst (Securities Valuation) | State Street HCL| May 2021 - Nov 2022

Developed and maintained pricing models for fixed income, equities, mutual funds, and derivatives

ensuring accuracy in daily valuations; documented methodologies for audit and compliance.

Performed daily validation of market data inputs (interest rates, FX rates, credit spreads) using Bloomberg,

Refinitiv/Reuters, ICE, and Markit to support accurate pricing.

Collaborated with Front Office, Risk teams to resolve pricing discrepancies and provide support for trading strategies. Automated manual pricing processes using Excel VBA, improving efficiency & reduced time -Acted as liaison between Middle Office, custodians, and clients to resolve settlement exceptions and pricing discrepancies. Monitored and managed daily exceptions, proactively escalating unresolved issues to internal and external stakeholders.

Reduced operational risk by proactively identifying recurring reconciliation issues and implementing

preventive controls to minimize repeat breaks.

Performed daily NAV calculation and validation for mutual funds and structured products, reconciling cash flows, corporate actions, and expenses to ensure accurate reporting.

Analyzed and validated prices of equities, bonds, OTC Cleared derivatives, Options, Futures.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Commerce in Financial Services | 2020

SKILLS

Pricing tools/ Valuation platforms- (Bloomberg, Markit, Reuters, Murex, Calypso, Aladdin, Amanda) - Market Knowledge - Euroclear, Murex, OMS, LISA, UBIX, Calypso, NSE NOW, NEAT, BSE, - Trade Lifecycle – End-to-End tradecapture, validation, confirmation, matching, clearing expiry management, and settlements, reconciliation across equities, fixed income, derivatives, and FX.

Excel (Advanced)- VBA macros, Pivot Table - Products- Fixed Income, Equities, Derivatives, FX, Repos, Structured products, Credit, OTC, ETD - Regulatory & RiskAwareness – EMIR, MiFID II, Dodd-Frank, FINRA, ISDA Documentation - Project Management – JIRA, Agile,Alteryx, Confluence, UAT testing, MIS & KPI Reports, ServiceNow - Custody & Asset Servicing – corporate actions, dividend/interest, Coupon & Reset Processing posting, settlement monitoring, custody transaction validation, SWIFT and securities lending. Conditional formatting

Reconciliation & Break Resolution – FOBO/MOBO, Nostro, cash and position reconciliations; aged break

exception management; Root Cause Analysis

Fund Administration- daily NAV calculation, fund accounting, performance reporting, fund services - Client Onboarding & Asset Transfers – portfolio setup, migrations, tax reclaims, account closures, Transfer Agency, KYC/AML, Clien Due Diligence and tranche management. - Stakeholder communication: Global teams, custodians, brokers, trading desks, clients, sales - Derivatives - Interest Rate Swaps (IRS),Cross Currency Swaps (CCS), Futures, Options, Listed Derivatives
